name: Carrion Defense Works Suppression Collar SC-4
product_name: Carrion Defense Works Suppression Collar SC-4
description: A locking collar device that suppresses all neural interface functions while worn, effectively de-augmenting the wearer without surgical removal of their implants. The SC-4 generates a precisely calibrated electromagnetic field that disrupts the neural interface's communication with brain tissue, shutting down all augmented functions — Diaspora access, cognitive enhancement, sensory augmentation, and cyberware control. The collar is locked with a biometric key and includes tamper detection that can administer a painful but non-lethal shock if removal is attempted. Carrion markets it to law enforcement for augmented prisoner management, but its use as a control device for involuntary subjects has been documented.

specifications.side effects: Disorientation and nausea during neural shutdown

story_hooks: SC-4 collars are being used by a trafficking operation to control augmented victims — the collars de-augment them, cutting them off from Diaspora communication and any ability to call for help.

A modified SC-4 has been developed that suppresses specific neural interface functions selectively — it can disable motor control cyberware while leaving sensory functions intact, creating a paralysis device that leaves the victim aware.
related_entities: TESSERA CORPONATION Aegis CorpSec Hardened Security BCI

physical_description.visual_profile: A rigid, menacing neck-worn restraint with a futuristic industrial aesthetic. The collar is composed of segmented panels that arc around the wearer's neck, meeting at a reinforced locking mechanism at the throat. The design is deliberately clinical and punitive—no softness, no compromise. It has the appearance of something that was engineered to control rather than comfort.
physical_description.dimensions: Approximately 35-40 cm circumference (adjustable), 5-7 cm height at front, 3-4 cm at back. Fits snugly against the neck and lower jaw.
physical_description.weight_description: 0.3 kg. Noticeable but not crushing—handheld weight on the neck, distributed across shoulder and collarbone contact points. Heavy enough to be psychologically present.
physical_description.primary_material: Hardened polymer composite with embedded copper-weave mesh for EM field generation. Reinforced steel locking clasp and biometric sensor hub.
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal gray with brushed industrial texture. The EM mesh creates subtle linear patterns visible under direct light. Locking mechanism has a polished chrome finish that contrasts sharply with the dull body.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary, chrome silver locking hardware, black biometric sensor strip running horizontally across the front throat section. Accent hints of cold blue glow from the EM field indicator lights when active.
physical_description.interface_elements: Biometric sensor pad (fingerprint/retinal) embedded in the front locking mechanism. Small LED status indicators (green/red) positioned above the sensor. Micro-USB charging port concealed under a rubber flap on the back right side. Haptic feedback zone where tamper detection triggers warnings.
distinctive_features: Segmented articulating design—individual panels allow slight flex without compromising field integrity
The locking mechanism is a prominent reinforced clasp with a glowing biometric sensor that's intimidatingly visible
Fine copper mesh visible through semi-transparent sections, suggesting the neural disruption technology beneath
Tamper detection wires running along interior edges, visible through slight gaps
A faint blue-white shimmer in the air immediately surrounding the collar when active—visible EM field distortion
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: CARRION DEFENSE WORKS logo stamped in small chrome lettering on the right side of the locking mechanism. Regulatory certification marks (Tier 3+ clearance required) laser-etched on the interior back. Serial number engraved on the left side panel. Small warning label with pictogram showing a neural interface being disrupted.
physical_description.condition_typical: When inactive: sterile, clinical appearance. When active: subtle blue-white corona visible around the device edges, micro-vibration barely perceptible to wearer but visible at close range. After extended wear: condensation sometimes forms on the interior polymer from body heat and the EM field generation.
